categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Nanshan Fashion Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: fine woolen fabric production, garment manufacturing (including professional attire and high-end custom clothing), and textile fiber production focusing on high-performance fibers such as ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and nylon fibers. The company integrates the entire industrial chain from raw wool processing to finished garments and branded retail.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including intelligent manufacturing systems, 5G+ industrial internet smart factories, and digital platforms for order management and production. It has proprietary patents in UHMWPE fiber production, including anti-creep and flame-retardant technologies, and uses international leading equipment from German Barmag and Japanese TMT for nylon fiber production. The firm also integrates CAD design, MES systems, and sustainable, green manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international luxury brands for high-end woolen fabrics, domestic and international professional uniform clients across sectors such as finance, public security, energy, and education, as well as industrial and military users for high-performance fibers. The company serves both domestic and overseas markets, including the US, Europe, Japan, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Yantai, Shandong Province. It has overseas subsidiaries in Australia and sales channels covering major global markets including North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets such as India and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanshan Fashion operates across the entire supply chain from upstream raw wool procurement and processing, midstream fabric and fiber production, to downstream garment manufacturing and branded retail. It controls key stages including raw material sourcing, textile production, garment assembly, and direct sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in high-performance fibers (UHMWPE and nylon), smart manufacturing, and sustainable textile technologies. R&D priorities include developing functional fabrics with properties like flame retardancy, anti-bacterial, anti-viral, and environmental friendliness. It invests in digital transformation, AI-driven design, and expanding new material applications in defense, marine, robotics, and outdoor apparel.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of fine woolen fabrics, professional and custom garments, and high-performance textile fibers. Sales channels include direct sales (87.6%) and distribution (12.4%), with domestic sales accounting for about 74.5% and exports 25.5%. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanshan Fashion is a leading player in China's fine woolen fabric and professional garment market, with strong international brand partnerships. It holds a leading domestic position in UHMWPE fiber production and is expanding in high-performance nylon fibers. The company competes with global fiber producers like DSM, Honeywell, and Toyobo in high-end fiber markets, leveraging technological innovation and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.62 billion, a slight increase of 0.98% over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 190.8 million, a 5.82% decrease. Total assets grew 25.64% to RMB 4.62 billion. The company is investing heavily in new material projects, including an 80,000-ton high-performance nylon fiber project and expanding UHMWPE fiber capacity to 3,600 tons annually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanshan Fashion emphasizes integrated full-industry chain control, combining traditional fine wool craftsmanship with cutting-edge fiber technology. Its products offer high quality, innovation, and sustainability, including proprietary high-strength, lightweight UHMWPE fibers with anti-creep and flame-retardant features. The company provides customized, smart manufacturing solutions and maintains strong brand influence in high-end markets, delivering differentiated value through technology, quality, and service.
